summary.text: Five Finger Fist Heart Sword is Sword Immortal Bo Qing's sword path immortal killer move. The caster raises a fist overhead and fires successive sword lights from each finger.

claims.text: In Lang Ya blessed land, Qin Bai Sheng, Vice Envoy of Shadow Sect, retracts his aura, places his palms together at his chest, shuts his eyes, and lowers his head. His right hand clenches into a fist and rises above his head. Fang Yuan recognizes the legendary Central Continent move and wonders how a Northern Plains Gu Immortal has it. First finger: Qin Bai Sheng raises his thumb and a sword light shoots from the fist, fast beyond belief, piercing Lang Ya land spirit’s forehead in the instant it leaves. Second finger, the index, pierces the right arm; third finger pierces the left. Both arms turn blurry. Fourth finger, the ring finger: a rank seven hairy man Gu Immortal appears in the pit and blocks the sword light. Qin Bai Sheng opens his eyes, lowers his arms, and dispels the move. He had wanted those hairy man Gu Immortals to show themselves.

At Luo Po Valley, Feng Jiu Ge names the stance as Bo Qing’s move, and Qin Bai Sheng confirms it. Bo Qing was Feng Jiu Ge’s senior in Spirit Affinity House. He failed his tribulation, his killer move inheritance mysteriously disappeared, Spirit Affinity House did not obtain it, and it landed in a Northern Plains Gu Immortal’s hands. Sect records say the move is extremely powerful and sharp. It is rumored that Bo Qing felt the majesty of Heaven and Earth and the difficulty of ascension, and created the move to show courage and pride in resisting heaven and earth by himself. The stance confronts heaven and earth: head lowered and eyes closed look like admission of defeat, but the caster is gathering all physical and mental strength for the sharpest attack, and the fist above the head shows how bold Bo Qing was.
Qin Bai Sheng is a soul path Gu Immortal who also cultivated metal path and has not a single sword path dao mark, yet with this move he could fight Feng Jiu Ge on equal grounds.

Immortal zombie Bo Qing activates it among his famous sword path killer moves against berserk destiny light deer; most of the deer die on the spot under sword lights, even those with wild Immortal Gu. His immortal zombie body still holds an unimaginable number of sword path dao marks, so the same killer move has a completely different effect from Qin Bai Sheng’s use.

In Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan claps his palms together at his chest, curls the fingers of his right hand as if grasping sword light, and raises that hand above his head. The thumb fires first and pierces a hole in Cloud Cover Continent; index and middle fingers follow. His last two fingers cannot stretch, and after three sword lights he has to stop. He has modified Bo Qing’s version, but with fewer sword path Immortal Gu and lower attainment the power stays about the same as the original, only at the peak of rank seven. Wisdom sword Immortal Gu at rank eight would raise the killer move to rank eight power, but it needs rank eight immortal essence, which he cannot produce yet.

Breaking out of Heavenly Court’s time path formation, Fang Yuan uses the same stance on Li Huang. The first sword light pierces Li Huang’s forehead and halves the flames of verdant sun flame cloak; each following finger weakens the cloak further. The move gets stronger as it progresses. The fourth sword leaves the cloak thin as a flickering candle. Fang Yuan announces a fifth sword; Li Huang panics, calls him Bo Qing, and splits into dozens of flame figures, but Fang Yuan flies out of the loophole instead. There was no fifth sword.

With rank eight cultivation and his own white litchi immortal essence, Fang Yuan can use wisdom sword Immortal Gu, which is one of the cores of the move, and thus the fourth sword. That is his limit at this time; the fifth sword needs other core sword path Immortal Gu.

In Heavenly Court, Fang Yuan in immemorial sword dragon form clenches dragon claws into a fist and his aura falls to almost nothing. Duke Long’s warning signs ring; he evades wildly. The first sword light is already in front of him as he sees it leave the claws. He forcibly turns aside; it still cuts from left shoulder to left chest, taking bones, scales, and part of the left lung. A hit to the head would have severed him at once. This is the first fatal threat he has felt in the battle. Every sword needs time to prepare; Duke Long sees that weakness and charges in the gap.

The sword lights are extremely fast but cannot curve. Duke Long may not ward them off, but he can watch Fang Yuan’s movement, judge the moment of firing, and dodge in advance. The most ideal setup is the first sword at long range, from an invulnerable position; each sword can push Duke Long near death. Dragon gate closes the distance and forces close combat, so the dragon body becomes an obstacle and even cover. After the second sword, Fang Yuan stops the move. He has modified it so he can cancel with no backlash, or treat each sword strike as an individual move; the thoughts required rise sharply, and he cannot use other offensive methods at the same time. Duke Long already knew Bo Qing’s original well enough to counter it if it had not been modified. Compared with time cutting edge, it has the advantage that it will not be forgotten.

When Shi Miao melts over Duke Long and pins him, Fang Yuan fires again: second, third, and fourth sword lights strike through Duke Long’s body, and the leftover force shakes Heaven Overseeing Tower. Shi Miao is struck as well and dies; Duke Long is left with three huge sword wounds, still breathing. Fang Yuan then points the fifth sword. The sword light seems to pierce through time and space; no one can block its speed.
